lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like matrix of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, organized into approximately five to six horizontal rows with relatively uniform spatial intervals between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of high-luminance blobs, creating a series of grid-like anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear ridges run horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal-facing side and shadow on the ventral-facing side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a distribution of approximately 12 to 15 high-luminance blobs within its silhouette, showing no significant localized clustering.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) clustered near the ventral and pectoral regions; high-contrast caustic light patterns are superimposed on the dorsal pigmentation due to surface refraction.
